title: Compatible pointwise étale charts of an iterated stack pullback
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme and let $F,G,H$ be categories fibred in groupoids over $\mathrm{Sch}/S$ [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Let $f:F\to G$ and $g:G\to H$ be based functors, with $f$ representable by algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Fix a scheme $T/S$, a map $t:h_T\to H$, an algebraic space $B$, and a projection $p_B:B\to h_T$ with a specified algebraic-space presentation of $T\times_H G$ compatible with $p_B$. Then there are an algebraic space $A$ and a projection $p_A:A\to h_T$ presenting $T\times_H F$ for the composite $gf$, with the following property. For every representable etale scheme chart $a:h_U\to A$ and every $x\in U$, there are a representable etale scheme chart $c:h_W\to B$ and a based functor $t_W:h_W\to G$ such that, for every algebraic-space presentation $M$ of $W\times_G F$ compatible with a projection $q:M\to h_W$, there are a scheme $V/S$, an etale map $r:V\to U$, a representable etale chart $b:h_V\to M$, and $v\in V$ such that $r(v)=x$ and the scheme maps $V\to T$ agree: $p_A a r=p_B c q b$. The displayed equality is written in Lean's left-to-right composition order as `r ≫ yoneda.preimage (a ≫ pA) = yoneda.preimage (b ≫ q) ≫ yoneda.preimage (c ≫ pB)`. All base-change presentations retain their actual projections and equivalences over $\mathrm{Sch}/S$. No horizontal morphism property or nonemptiness is assumed.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-representable-pullback-over-space] to f over B, using the G-projection of its displayed test equivalence. The iterated pullback is an algebraic space A. Reassociate its triples by composing the comparison isomorphisms; the inverse inserts the repeated intermediate object and an identity isomorphism. This retains the T-projection p_A and gives HasSpaceBaseChange for gf.

Choose a surjective étale scheme atlas W→B [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Form U×_B W by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Its projection to U is étale and surjective by the scheme-test definitions and base-change permanence. Choose a surjective étale scheme chart V of that space. The composite r:V→U is étale and surjective, so some v maps to x. Composition and base-change permanence here use [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation], [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change], [lem-trf-surjective-morphism-composition], and [lem-weil-pbc-surjective-base-change].

Define t_W by composing W→B with the G-projection of the given presentation of B. For any presentation M,q of its f-test, the same triple reassociation identifies M with A×_B W. Under this identification U×_B W→M is a base change of the étale chart U→A, hence is étale; composing the chart V gives the required b. Both routes V→T are projections of the same tuple, so they agree. This proves the displayed equality for any chosen presentation M, not just one atlas [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids, lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change, lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. Empty U makes the pointwise assertion vacuous.

theorem stack_composite_chart_refinement
    {S : Scheme.{u}}
    {F : BasedCategory.{v₁, w₁} (Over S)} {G : BasedCategory.{v₂, w₂} (Over S)}
    {H : BasedCategory.{v₃, w₃} (Over S)}
    (hF : IsFibredInGroupoids F) (hG : IsFibredInGroupoids G)
    (hH : IsFibredInGroupoids H) (f : BasedFunctor F G) (g : BasedFunctor G H)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces f)
    (T : Over S) (t : BasedFunctor (discreteModuli (yoneda.obj T)) H)
    (ZB : AlgebraicSpace S) (pB : ZB.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj T)
    (hB : HasSpaceBaseChange g T t ZB pB) :
    ∃ (ZA : AlgebraicSpace S) (pA : ZA.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj T),
      HasSpaceBaseChange (f.comp g) T t ZA pA ∧
        ∀ (U : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ ZA.obj.obj),
          AlgebraicSpace.IsEtale a → ∀ x : U.left,
          ∃ (W : Over S) (c : yoneda.obj W ⟶ ZB.obj.obj),
            AlgebraicSpace.IsEtale c ∧
              ∃ tW : BasedFunctor (discreteModuli (yoneda.obj W)) G,
                ∀ (M : AlgebraicSpace S) (q : M.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj W),
                  HasSpaceBaseChange f W tW M q →
                    ∃ (V : Over S) (r : V ⟶ U) (b : yoneda.obj V ⟶ M.obj.obj)
                      (v : V.left),
                      Etale r.left ∧ AlgebraicSpace.IsEtale b ∧ r.left v = x ∧
                        r ≫ yoneda.preimage (a ≫ pA) =
                          yoneda.preimage (b ≫ q) ≫ yoneda.preimage (c ≫ pB)
